decision: Identify recurring visible football problems across a modest preselected panel before choosing another long wave of narrow fixes.
checkpoint: Rank recurring visible football problems on one accepted build across preselected ordinary runs and passes before another feature wave
selection: All four capability-selected, frozen 11/nickel lineups in config/roster-screen.json, crossed with all twelve declared calls. Calls, seeds, fronts and coverages are fixed before seeing outcomes. No outcome filters, substitutions, seed replacement or rerolls.
limitations: A balanced diagnostic panel is not a random sample of simulator usage or NFL football; report frequencies within declared exposures only.
Four selected matchups, one seed per call, fresh energy, first-and-ten, midfield, 11 personnel and nickel defense; no game history, fatigue, heavy packages, short yardage, goal line or special teams.
Concept, front, coverage and seed vary together; this panel does not isolate causal effects of those inputs.
Full replay telemetry is sampled observer data, not a complete impulse history or proof of decision causes. Missing causes remain unknown.
